tree.heading: Profit and Stock.—
tree.text: The corporation shall be nonprofit and may not issue stock.

tree.heading: Political Activities.—
tree.text: The corporation shall be nonpolitical and nonsectarian, and may not promote the candidacy of an individual seeking public office.

tree.heading: Honorary Members.—
tree.text: The corporation may not have honorary members.
